title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A classic Italian pizza with a crispy thin crust, rich tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, and aromatic basil leaves.
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned crushed San Marzano tomatoes

instructions.title: Preheat the oven
instructions.description: Preheat your oven to its highest setting (usually 500°F/260°C) with a pizza stone inside for at least 45 minutes.

instructions.title: Shape the dough
instructions.description: On a floured surface, gently stretch the pizza dough into a 12-inch circle. Keep the edges slightly thicker for a nice crust.

instructions.title: Add sauce and cheese
instructions.description: Spread the crushed tomatoes evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Arrange the fresh mozzarella slices on top.

instructions.title: Bake the pizza
instructions.description: Transfer the pizza to the preheated stone. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Remove from oven. Immediately top with fresh basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with sea salt. Slice and enjoy!

title: Authentic Shoyu Ramen
description: A comforting Japanese noodle soup with a soy sauce-based chicken and dashi broth, tender chashu pork, and soft-boiled ramen egg.
ingredients: Nori sheets and bamboo shoots (menma) for topping

instructions.title: Prepare the broth
instructions.description: Simmer chicken broth with kombu, ginger, and garlic on low heat for 1.5 hours. Discard kombu after 30 minutes to prevent bitterness.

instructions.title: Make the Shoyu Tare
instructions.description: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, a splash of sake, and a pinch of sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes and set aside.

instructions.title: Boil noodles and warm toppings
instructions.description: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook fresh ramen noodles for 2 minutes. Warm your chashu pork slices in a hot pan.

instructions.title: Assemble the bowls
instructions.description: Place 2 tablespoons of tare in each bowl. Pour in 2 cups of hot broth and stir. Add cooked noodles, folding them neatly.

instructions.title: Add toppings and serve
instructions.description: Top with pork slices, half a soft-boiled egg, bamboo shoots, nori sheet, and a generous handful of green onions. Serve hot.

title: Gourmet Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in a creamy, homemade Caesar dressing, topped with garlic-herb croutons and freshly shaved Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce, washed and chopped
2 anchovy fillets (optional, or 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce)
Salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.title: Bake the croutons
instructions.description: Toss bread cubes with olive oil, salt, and garlic powder. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 10 minutes until golden and crunchy.

instructions.title: Make the dressing
instructions.description: Whisk egg yolk, minced garlic, lemon juice, anchovy paste, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Slowly drizzle olive oil while whisking vigorously.

instructions.title: Toss the greens
instructions.description: Place dried, chopped romaine lettuce in a large wooden bowl. Drizzle half the dressing over the top and toss to coat evenly.

instructions.title: Assemble and garnish
instructions.description: Add croutons, grated Parmesan, and remaining dressing. Toss gently. Top with shaved Parmesan curls and fresh cracked black pepper.

title: Decadent Chocolate Lava Cake
description: A rich chocolate cake with a warm, molten chocolate center. A showstopping dessert that is deceptively easy to make.
ingredients: Powdered sugar and fresh raspberries (optional, for serving)

instructions.title: Prep ramekins and oven
instructions.description: Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C). Butter two 6-ounce ramekins generously and dust with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess.

instructions.title: Melt chocolate and butter
instructions.description: Microwave chocolate and butter in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second increments until melted. Stir until completely smooth.

instructions.title: Whip eggs and sugar
instructions.description: Using an electric mixer, beat the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt together at high speed until pale, thick, and doubled in volume.

instructions.title: Combine ingredients
instructions.description: Gently fold the melted chocolate mixture and flour into the whipped eggs using a rubber spatula until just combined. Do not overmix.

instructions.title: Bake and invert
instructions.description: Divide batter between ramekins. Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges are firm but center is soft. Cool for 1 minute, invert onto plates, dust with powdered sugar.

title: Double Smash Cheeseburger
description: Crispy-edged beef patties, melted American cheese, caramelized onions, and secret burger sauce on a toasted brioche bun.
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef (80/20 blend, divided into two balls)

instructions.title: Toast the bun and prep sauce
instructions.description: Spread butter on the buns and toast them in a hot skillet until golden. Mix mayo, mustard, relish, and a dash of pepper in a bowl to make the sauce.

instructions.title: Sear the onions
instructions.description: Place sliced onions in the hot cast iron skillet. Place beef balls directly on top of the onions.

instructions.title: Smash the patties
instructions.description: Using a heavy spatula or burger press, smash the patties down as flat as possible. Season generously with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Flip and add cheese
instructions.description: Scrape underneath the patties and flip them over. Immediately place a slice of American cheese on each patty. Cook for 1 minute until cheese melts.

instructions.title: Assemble the burger
instructions.description: Spread sauce on the bottom bun. Stack the two cheesy patties on top of each other. Cover with the top bun and serve immediately.

title: Classic Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender pieces of marinated chicken grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, creamy, spiced tomato curry sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions.title: Marinate the chicken
instructions.description: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, half the garlic-ginger paste, garam masala, cumin, and turmeric in a bowl. Add chicken and marinate for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Sear the chicken
instructions.description: Heat a large skillet or grill pan. Sear chicken pieces in batches until browned on all sides. They do not need to be cooked all the way through.

instructions.title: Build the sauce
instructions.description: Melt butter in a pan. Sauté chopped onions, remaining garlic-ginger paste, and a dash of spices for 5 minutes. Pour in tomato puree and simmer.

instructions.title: Simmer chicken in sauce
instructions.description: Add the seared chicken pieces into the simmering tomato sauce. Cook on low heat for 15 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through.

instructions.title: Add cream and garnish
instructions.description: Stir in the heavy cream and let simmer for another 2 minutes. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve with garlic naan.

title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Light, fluffy, and golden-brown buttermilk pancakes. Perfect for a weekend family brunch served with butter and pure maple syrup.
ingredients: Butter and maple syrup for serving

instructions.title: Mix dry ingredients
instructions.description: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

instructions.title: Whisk wet ingredients
instructions.description: In another bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.

instructions.title: Combine dry and wet
instructions.description: Pour wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir with a spatula until just combined. The batter should be thick and lumpy.

instructions.title: Cook on griddle
instructions.description: Heat a non-stick griddle over medium heat and grease with butter. Pour 1/3 cup of batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top.

instructions.title: Flip and finish
instructions.description: Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown on the other side. Serve immediately with syrup.

title: Fresh Strawberry Mojito
description: A refreshing summer drink featuring muddled fresh strawberries, mint leaves, lime juice, rum, and fizzy soda water.
ingredients: Extra mint and strawberry for garnish

instructions.title: Muddle fruit and herbs
instructions.description: In a tall glass, combine strawberries, mint leaves, lime wedges, and sugar. Use a muddler to gently press and release juices.

instructions.title: Add rum and ice
instructions.description: Pour in white rum and fill the glass with crushed or cubed ice.

instructions.title: Top with soda and stir
instructions.description: Top with club soda. Stir well from the bottom up to distribute the fruit flavors. Garnish with a mint sprig and serve.

title: Tacos Al Pastor
description: Stunning Mexican street tacos with thin slices of marinated spit-roasted pork, grilled pineapple, cilantro, and onions on warm corn tortillas.

instructions.title: Blend the marinade
instructions.description: Blend achiote paste, chipotles, pineapple juice, vinegar, garlic, oregano, cumin, and salt until smooth. Pour over pork and marinate for 4 hours.

instructions.title: Cook the pork
instructions.description: Grill or pan-fry marinated pork slices in a hot skillet with a little oil until nicely charred and fully cooked. Chop into small pieces.

instructions.title: Grill pineapple and toast tortillas
instructions.description: Grill pineapple slices until caramelized, then chop. Warm corn tortillas on a dry skillet until soft and pliable.

instructions.title: Assemble tacos
instructions.description: Double stack two tortillas. Fill with pork, top with grilled pineapple, onions, and fresh cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Healthy Avocado Toast
description: Creamy mashed avocado on toasted artisanal sourdough bread, topped with a soft-poached egg, chili flakes, and microgreens.
ingredients: Sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.title: Toast the sourdough
instructions.description: Drizzle sourdough bread with a little olive oil and toast on a grill pan until crispy and marked.

instructions.title: Mash the avocado
instructions.description: Mash avocado flesh with lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Keep it slightly chunky.

instructions.title: Poach the egg
instructions.description: Bring water to a simmer with a splash of vinegar. Whirl the water to create a vortex, slip in the cracked egg, and cook for 3 minutes.

instructions.title: Assemble and serve
instructions.description: Spread mashed avocado onto the toast. Slide the poached egg on top. Garnish with red pepper flakes, black pepper, and microgreens.

title: Classic Pad Thai
description: The quintessential Thai street food noodle dish: rice noodles stir-fried with firm tofu, eggs, bean sprouts, and peanuts in a tangy tamarind sauce.
ingredients: Lime wedges and red pepper flakes

instructions.title: Soak noodles and prep sauce
instructions.description: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until soft. Whisk tamarind paste, palm sugar, and soy sauce with hot water to dissolve sugar.

instructions.title: Fry tofu and aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a wok. Fry tofu cubes until golden. Add minced garlic and shallots, cooking for 30 seconds.

instructions.title: Scramble the eggs
instructions.description: Push tofu to the side of the wok. Pour in eggs and scramble until set, then mix with tofu.

instructions.title: Toss noodles and sauce
instructions.description: Add drained noodles and tamarind sauce. Stir-fry rapidly, tossing continuously, until noodles absorb sauce and become tender.

instructions.title: Add final garnishes
instructions.description: Toss in bean sprouts, green onions, and half the crushed peanuts. Serve with lime wedges, remaining peanuts, and red pepper flakes.

title: Vegetable Dum Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables, caramelized onions, fresh herbs, and saffron milk, slow-cooked to perfection.
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, potatoes, beans)
2 large onions, thinly sliced and fried until crispy
1/2 cup fresh mint and cilantro, chopped
1/2 tsp saffron threads dissolved in 2 tbsp warm milk
Whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf)

instructions.title: Parboil the rice
instructions.description: Wash and soak Basmati rice for 30 minutes. Boil in salted water with whole spices until 70% cooked. Drain and set aside.

instructions.title: Marinate the vegetables
instructions.description: Mix chopped vegetables with yogurt, biryani masala, half the fried onions, mint, cilantro, oil, and salt. Let sit for 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook vegetable layer
instructions.description: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add marinated vegetables and cook for 10 minutes until par-cooked.

instructions.title: Layer and Dum
instructions.description: Layer parboiled rice over the cooked vegetables. Sprinkle saffron milk, remaining fried onions, ghee, mint, and cilantro. Seal pot with dough or foil.

instructions.title: Slow cook and fluff
instructions.description: Cook on very low heat (dum) for 25-30 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes, then gently fluff layers and serve warm with raita.

title: Artisanal Garlic Herb Sourdough
description: Crusty, slow-fermented sourdough bread packed with roasted garlic cloves and fresh chopped rosemary.

instructions.title: Mix the dough
instructions.description: Combine flour, water, sourdough starter, and salt in a bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then let it rest for 30 minutes.

instructions.title: Fold in herbs and garlic
instructions.description: Gently stretch the dough and fold in the minced garlic and fresh rosemary. Perform stretch-and-folds every 30 minutes for 2 hours.

instructions.title: Bulk fermentation
instructions.description: Cover the dough and let it rise at room temperature for 4 to 6 hours, or until it has doubled in size.

instructions.title: Shape and cold proof
instructions.description: Shape the dough into a tight round loaf. Place in a proofing basket, cover, and refrigerate overnight for 12 hours for deep flavor.

instructions.title: Bake in Dutch oven
instructions.description: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with a Dutch oven inside. Score the loaf, place in the hot Dutch oven, cover with lid, and bake for 20 minutes. Bake 20 minutes uncovered.

title: Soft Garlic Butter Naan
description: Traditional Indian flatbread cooked on a hot skillet, brushed with garlic butter and garnished with fresh cilantro.

instructions.title: Activate yeast and knead
instructions.description: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Add flour, salt, yogurt, and 1 tbsp melted butter. Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

instructions.title: First rise
instructions.description: Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.

instructions.title: Divide and shape
instructions.description: Divide the dough into 6 equal portions. Roll each portion into an oval shape about 1/4 inch thick. Press minced garlic and cilantro onto one side.

instructions.title: Cook on skillet
instructions.description: Heat a heavy cast-iron skillet over high heat. Brush the plain side of the naan with water, then place it water-side down on the hot skillet. Cook until bubbles form.

instructions.title: Flip and brush with butter
instructions.description: Flip the naan and cook for another minute until charred spots appear. Remove from skillet and immediately brush with melted garlic butter.

title: Authentic Mango Lassi
description: A creamy, smooth, and refreshing classic Indian drink made with sweet mangoes, yogurt, a touch of cardamom, and saffron.
ingredients: 1 cup ripe mango pulp or fresh cubed mango

instructions.title: Prep the mangoes
instructions.description: Peel and chop fresh sweet mangoes into cubes, discarding the pit. Ensure they are cold for a refreshing drink.

instructions.title: Blend ingredients
instructions.description: Add mango cubes, Greek yogurt, milk, honey, and ground cardamom to a high-speed blender.

instructions.title: Blend until smooth
instructions.description: Blend on high for 1-2 minutes until completely smooth, frothy, and thick. Adjust sweetness or thickness if desired.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Pour into glasses over ice. Garnish with a sprinkle of ground cardamom and a few saffron threads. Serve chilled immediately.

title: Quinoa Avocado Buddha Bowl
description: A nutrient-rich and colorful grain bowl featuring fluffy quinoa, ripe avocado, fresh spinach, and seasoned roasted chickpeas.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions.title: Cook the quinoa
instructions.description: Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine quinoa and water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Roast chickpeas
instructions.description: Toss chickpeas with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in a pan on medium-high heat until slightly crispy (about 8 minutes).

instructions.title: Prepare dressing
instructions.description: Whisk together remaining olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper to create a zesty dressing.

instructions.title: Assemble the bowl
instructions.description: Divide cooked quinoa into two bowls. Arrange slices of avocado, spinach, roasted chickpeas, tomatoes, and cucumber in sections on top.

instructions.title: Drizzle dressing and serve
instructions.description: Drizzle the lemon dressing over the bowls, garnish with sesame seeds or microgreens, and serve fresh.

title: Classic Italian Tiramisu
description: An elegant, traditional Italian dessert layered with espresso-soaked ladyfingers and a rich, velvety mascarpone cream.

instructions.title: Whip egg yolks and sugar
instructions.description: In a bowl over a pot of simmering water, whisk egg yolks and sugar for 5 minutes until pale and creamy. Remove from heat and let cool.

instructions.title: Incorporate mascarpone
instructions.description: Gently fold the mascarpone cheese into the cooled egg yolk mixture until smooth and combined.

instructions.title: Whip heavy cream
instructions.description: In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Gently fold this into the mascarpone cream.

instructions.title: Dip ladyfingers
instructions.description: Quickly dip ladyfinger cookies into the cold espresso. Arrange them in a single layer in a serving dish.

instructions.title: Layer and dust cocoa
instructions.description: Spread half the mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers. Add another layer of ladyfingers, top with remaining cream, and dust with cocoa powder. Chill for 4 hours.

title: Butter Chicken
description: Tender pieces of chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, seared and simmered in a luscious, velvety tomato-butter gravy.

instructions.title: Marinate the chicken
instructions.description: Marinate chicken with yogurt, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, and salt for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.description: Cook chicken in a hot pan until lightly browned and seared on all sides.

instructions.title: Sauté the onions
instructions.description: Heat butter in a pan and sauté the chopped onion until golden brown.

instructions.title: Cook ginger-garlic paste
instructions.description: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes until the raw aroma disappears.

instructions.title: Simmer in tomato gravy
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, cook until oil separates. Stir in the chicken, simmer for 10 minutes, and mix in cream.

instructions.title: Garnish and serve
instructions.description: Garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with warm butter naan or steamed basmati rice.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Soft cottage cheese cubes simmered in a velvety, buttery tomato-based gravy seasoned with delicate spices.

instructions.title: Fry the paneer
instructions.description: Fry paneer cubes lightly in a pan with butter until slightly golden on the edges.

instructions.title: Cook the onions
instructions.description: Sauté the chopped onions in butter until golden brown and soft.

instructions.title: Sauté ginger-garlic
instructions.description: Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute until aromatic.

instructions.title: Thicken the tomato puree
instructions.description: Add tomato puree, chili powder, and cook until thick and fat starts separating.

instructions.title: Incorporate paneer and cream
instructions.description: Add paneer, garam masala, salt, and mix in cream. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Chole
description: A classic North Indian chickpea curry cooked in a spicy, tangy onion-tomato gravy with special chole spices.

instructions.title: Sauté onions and spices
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Fry the chopped onions until deep golden brown.

instructions.title: Add ginger-garlic and tomato
instructions.description: Add ginger-garlic paste, then add tomato puree and cook well until oil separates.

instructions.title: Simmer chickpeas
instructions.description: Add chole masala, boiled chickpeas, and pour in water. Simmer for 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Thicken the gravy
instructions.description: Mash a few chickpeas with the back of your spoon for thickness. Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Palak Paneer
description: Cubes of fresh paneer in a creamy, green, and vibrant spiced spinach puree gravy.

instructions.title: Blanch and blend spinach
instructions.description: Boil spinach for 2 minutes, then plunge in cold water. Blend into a smooth puree.

instructions.title: Sauté the base
instructions.description: Fry chopped onions, then add garlic and ginger. Sauté until lightly gold.

instructions.title: Build the spinach sauce
instructions.description: Add spinach puree, salt, and spices. Simmer for 3 minutes on low heat.

instructions.title: Cook with paneer
instructions.description: Add paneer cubes and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in cream and serve hot.

title: Kashmiri Rajma Masala
description: Rich red kidney beans slow-cooked in a spiced tomato-onion curry gravy, served classically with steamed rice.

instructions.title: Pressure cook rajma
instructions.description: Pressure cook soaked kidney beans until tender. Set aside.

instructions.title: Build the gravy base
instructions.description: Fry chopped onions, then add ginger-garlic paste and tomato puree. Cook until oil separates.

instructions.title: Simmer beans in gravy
instructions.description: Add rajma masala and salt. Add kidney beans along with water and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with hot rice.

title: South Indian Masala Dosa
description: Crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe stuffed with a dry, seasoned potato-onion mash.

instructions.title: Spread the batter
instructions.description: Heat a flat dosa pan. Spread dosa batter thinly in circular spirals. Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

instructions.title: Assemble potatoes
instructions.description: Add seasoned potato filling in the center of the crispy crepe.

instructions.title: Fold and serve
instructions.description: Fold the dosa neatly. Serve hot with coconut chutney and tasty sambar.

title: Soft Steamed Idlis
description: Healthy, soft, and fluffy steamed cakes made from fermented rice and black lentil batter.

instructions.title: Pour batter into moulds
instructions.description: Grease idli moulds. Pour fermented batter into each mould compartment.

instructions.title: Steam cook idlis
instructions.description: Steam in an idli cooker for 12 minutes until cooked and puffy. Cool slightly and remove idlis.

instructions.title: Garnish and enjoy
instructions.description: Serve hot. Enjoy with warm sambar and fresh coconut chutney.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
description: Richly spiced Basmati rice layered with marinated chicken, saffron, fried onions, mint, and slow-cooked (dum) to locking absolute flavor.

instructions.title: Marinate the chicken
instructions.description: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garam masala, and spices. Boil basmati rice until 70% done.

instructions.title: Layer rice and masala
instructions.description: Prepare chicken masala. Layer rice, chicken, fried onions, fresh mint, and coriander in a pot.

instructions.title: Dum cook
instructions.description: Drizzle ghee and saffron milk over top layer. Cover tightly, cook on low heat for 30 minutes.

title: Crispy Punjabi Samosa
description: Golden, crispy pastry shells filled with a spiced potato and green peas mash, served with sweet tamarind chutney.

instructions.title: Knead pastry dough
instructions.description: Make dough with flour, salt, carom seeds, oil, and water. Rest for 20 minutes.

instructions.title: Prepare potato filling
instructions.description: Sauté mashed potatoes, peas, and spices in a pan. Let cool.

instructions.title: Shape and fry
instructions.description: Roll dough, cut into halves, form cones, fill with potato mixture, seal edges, and deep fry until golden.

title: Soft Milk-Solid Gulab Jamun
description: Warm milk-powder dumplings lightly fried and soaked in a sweet cardamom-infused sugar syrup.

instructions.title: Prepare cardamom syrup
instructions.description: Boil sugar and water with cardamoms for 10 minutes to prepare sugar syrup.

instructions.title: Knead gulab jamun dough
instructions.description: Mix milk powder, flour, baking powder, ghee, and milk. Knead into a soft dough and make smooth balls.

instructions.title: Fry and soak
instructions.description: Fry balls on low heat until golden. Soak in warm syrup and rest for 2 hours.

title: Poha
description: A light and healthy Indian breakfast staple made of flattened rice flakes sautéed with onions, potatoes, mustard seeds, and turmeric.

instructions.title: Wash and drain poha
instructions.description: Wash the poha under running water in a colander, drain all water completely, and keep aside to soften.

instructions.title: Sauté mustard and aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, let them crackle, then add curry leaves and chopped green chilies.

instructions.title: Cook onions and potatoes
instructions.description: Add chopped onions and cook until soft. Add diced potatoes and cook on low heat until they are completely tender.

instructions.title: Combine and serve
instructions.description: Stir in turmeric powder, salt, and washed poha. Mix gently. Cook for 3-4 minutes, add lemon juice, garnish with chopped coriander, and serve.

title: Upma
description: A popular South Indian breakfast dish made by cooking dry-roasted semolina with water, vegetables, and seasoned tempered spices.

instructions.title: Roast semolina
instructions.description: Dry roast semolina in a heavy-bottomed pan on low heat until aromatic. Keep aside.

instructions.title: Prepare seasoning
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, chopped onions, and chilies. Sauté until onions soften.

instructions.title: Simmer water and combine
instructions.description: Pour in water, add salt, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and add semolina slowly while stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Cook until thick.

title: Medu Vada
description: Crispy, deep-fried fritters shaped like doughnuts, made of fermented black lentil (urad dal) batter.

instructions.title: Soak and grind dal
instructions.description: Soak urad dal for 4 hours. Grind into a thick, fluffy batter using minimal water. Mix in ginger, chili, curry leaves, and salt.

instructions.title: Shape and deep fry
instructions.description: Wet your hands. Take a portion of batter, shape it like a doughnut with a hole in the center, and slip gently into hot oil.

instructions.title: Drain and serve
instructions.description: Fry until golden brown and crispy. Drain excess oil and serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.

title: Pav Bhaji
description: A delicious spiced blend of mashed mixed vegetables cooked in a pool of butter, served hot with toasted pav buns.

instructions.title: Boil and mash vegetables
instructions.description: Boil mixed vegetables and potatoes in a cooker. Mash them completely into a smooth mixture.

instructions.title: Build butter gravy base
instructions.description: Cook chopped onions in butter until golden. Add tomatoes, pav bhaji masala, salt, and the mashed vegetables.

instructions.title: Simmer and toast buns
instructions.description: Simmer the bhaji for 10 minutes on medium heat. Toast pav buns on a hot tawa with a slab of butter. Garnish bhaji with coriander and serve with lemon.

title: Vada Pav
description: The ultimate Mumbai street food: a spiced potato dumpling fried in gram flour batter, sandwiched in a soft pav with garlic chutney.

instructions.title: Prepare potato fritters
instructions.description: Roll spiced potato mixture into balls. Dip in a thick gram flour batter and deep fry until crispy and golden.

instructions.title: Assemble Vada Pav
instructions.description: Slice the pav buns. Spread garlic dry chutney, place the potato fritter inside, and serve hot.

title: Aloo Paratha
description: Golden skillet flatbread stuffed with a seasoned spicy potato filling, cooked with ghee and served with yogurt.

instructions.title: Prepare dough and stuffing
instructions.description: Make dough with wheat flour. Mix potatoes with green chili, coriander, garam masala, and salt.

instructions.title: Assemble and roll paratha
instructions.description: Roll out a portion of dough, place a scoop of potato stuffing, seal, and roll again into a flatbread.

instructions.title: Cook on tawa skillet
instructions.description: Cook on a hot tawa. Apply ghee, cook both sides until golden spots appear. Serve with yogurt and pickles.

title: Stuffed Capsicum
description: Tender green bell peppers stuffed with a spicy potato and green pea mixture, pan-cooked to a perfect soft finish.

instructions.title: Prepare potato filling
instructions.description: Sauté mashed potatoes, peas, and spices in a pan. Cut the tops off the bell peppers, clean the seeds, and stuff tightly.

instructions.title: Cook capsicum
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pan, arrange capsicums, cover, and cook on low heat. Turn occasionally until tender.

title: Baingan Bharta
description: Fire-roasted eggplant mashed and cooked with onions, tomatoes, garlic, and aromatic Indian spices.

instructions.title: Roast and mash eggplant
instructions.description: Roast the eggplant directly over an open flame until charred. Peel the skin and mash the pulp.

instructions.title: Cook with aromatics
instructions.description: Cook chopped onions, garlic, and tomatoes. Add mashed eggplant, spices, cook for 10 minutes, and serve hot.

title: Bhindi Masala
description: Crispy pan-fried okra tossed in a seasoned tomato-onion dry masala base.

instructions.title: Prep and fry bhindi
instructions.description: Slice clean dry okra. Fry okra until slightly tender and set aside.

instructions.title: Toss and finish cooking
instructions.description: Cook onions and tomatoes. Add spices, fold in okra, cook for 5 minutes, garnish, and serve.

title: Jeera Rice
description: Premium Basmati rice sautéed in ghee and whole cumin seeds, making the perfect companion for dals and curries.

instructions.title: Tamper cumin in ghee
instructions.description: Heat ghee in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle. Pour cumin ghee over cooked rice, add salt, mix gently, and serve.

title: Lemon Rice
description: Crispy-tempered South Indian rice mixed with fresh lemon juice, roasted peanuts, mustard seeds, and curry leaves.

instructions.title: Sauté seasoning
instructions.description: Heat oil. Add mustard seeds, peanuts, curry leaves, and turmeric. Roast peanuts until crunchy.

instructions.title: Combine with lemon juice
instructions.description: Add cooked rice, mix well, stir in fresh lemon juice gently, and serve cold or warm.

title: Tamarind Rice
description: A tangy, spicy rice dish prepared with tamarind pulp, peanuts, and aromatic tempering spices.

instructions.title: Cook tamarind paste
instructions.description: Prepare tamarind sauce. Heat oil, fry peanuts, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Mix sauce, add rice, mix well, and serve.

title: Vegetable Pulao
description: One-pot spiced rice dish cooked with mixed vegetables and fragrant whole spices.

instructions.title: Sauté rice and spices
instructions.description: Heat ghee, add whole spices, cook sliced onions, then add vegetables, rice, pour water, and cook until done.

title: Veg Fried Rice
description: Steamed rice stir-fried in a hot wok with finely chopped carrots, beans, bell peppers, soy sauce, and spring onions.

instructions.title: Wok fry veggies
instructions.description: Heat oil in a wok. Stir-fry the vegetables for 3-4 minutes. Add spring onions, soy sauce, and black pepper.

instructions.title: Toss with cold rice
instructions.description: Add cold cooked rice, toss everything together gently, cook for 2-3 minutes, and garnish with spring onion greens.

title: Chicken Curry
description: A classic homestyle Indian chicken curry cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and special chicken curry spices.

instructions.title: Sauté base aromatics
instructions.description: Heat oil in a pot. Fry chopped onions until deep golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.

instructions.title: Add tomatoes and chicken
instructions.description: Add tomatoes and chicken masala. Mix in chicken, cook for 10 minutes until chicken is seared. Pour in water, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until chicken is tender.

title: Fish Curry
description: Goan-style coastal fish curry cooked with mild spices and rich, creamy coconut milk gravy.

instructions.title: Simmer coconut gravy
instructions.description: Heat oil. Sauté onions and tomatoes. Add turmeric and chili powder. Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.

instructions.title: Poach fish
instructions.description: Add fish pieces gently into the simmering gravy. Cook for 10 minutes on low heat until the fish is tender and flakes easily. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Egg Curry
description: Boiled eggs cooked in a delicious, spicy onion-tomato gravy with curry spices.

instructions.title: Build curry gravy
instructions.description: Boil and peel eggs. Fry onions, ginger-garlic paste, and tomatoes in a pan. Add spices and a splash of water, simmer.

instructions.title: Add eggs
instructions.description: Make small slits in the boiled eggs. Place them in the simmering gravy and cook for 10 minutes until eggs absorb the flavor.

title: Rogan Josh
description: A signature Kashmiri mutton (lamb) dish cooked with yogurt, Kashmiri red chilies, and flavored with cardamom and ginger.

instructions.title: Sear meat and build gravy
instructions.description: Heat oil. Brown onions, add ginger-garlic paste, and spices. Stir in yogurt and add mutton pieces. Cook mutton on high heat.

instructions.title: Slow cook until tender
instructions.description: Add water, cover tightly, and simmer on low heat for 40-50 minutes until the mutton is melt-in-your-mouth tender.

title: Mutton Keema
description: Finely minced mutton cooked with onions, tomatoes, fresh green peas, and warm garam masala.

instructions.title: Cook minced meat base
instructions.description: Fry onions, then add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, and spices. Sauté minced meat, stirring constantly to break lumps.

instructions.title: Add peas and simmer
instructions.description: Add green peas, splash of water, simmer for 15 minutes until meat is cooked completely. Garnish with coriander.

title: Prawn Masala
description: Spicy, dry-cooked prawns in an onion-tomato gravy with red chili, turmeric, and lime juice.

instructions.title: Sauté prawn gravy
instructions.description: Clean prawns. Fry onions, ginger-garlic paste, and tomatoes. Add spices, fold in prawns, and cook for 8 minutes. Garnish and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka
description: Marinated boneless chicken skewers baked in the oven until tender and smoky on the edges.

instructions.title: Marinate chicken skewers
instructions.description: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, and tikka masala for 2 hours.

instructions.title: Bake chicken
instructions.description: Preheat oven. Arrange chicken on skewers, bake at 220°C for 20 minutes, turn halfway, brush with butter, and serve hot.

title: Tandoori Chicken
description: Classic whole chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and tandoori spices, grilled to absolute perfection.

instructions.title: Prepare cuts and marinate
instructions.description: Make deep cuts in chicken pieces, marinate with yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, and tandoori masala. Rest for 2 hours.

instructions.title: Grill or bake chicken
instructions.description: Bake or grill chicken, turn occasionally, brush with butter, cook completely, and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Chicken Korma
description: A Mughlai style chicken dish simmered in a rich, velvety yogurt-cashew paste gravy.

instructions.title: Simmer chicken in yogurt cashew base
instructions.description: Fry onions. Add chicken, spices, yogurt, and cashew paste. Cover and cook until chicken is soft. Stir in heavy cream and simmer.

title: Dhokla
description: Steamed savory chickpea flour (gram flour) cake topped with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies.

instructions.title: Steam dhokla batter
instructions.description: Mix gram flour, yogurt, turmeric, and water into a smooth batter. Stir in Eno fruit salt, pour into a greased tray, and steam for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Apply tempering
instructions.description: Prepare tempering by heating oil and crackling mustard seeds, curry leaves, and sliced green chilies. Pour over steamed dhokla, cut, and serve.

title: Khandvi
description: Delicate, thin rolled Gujarati snacks made from gram flour and yogurt, tempered with sesame and mustard seeds.

instructions.title: Cook and spread batter
instructions.description: Mix gram flour, yogurt, and water. Cook on low heat, stirring continuously, until thick. Spread thinly over a greased surface immediately.

instructions.title: Roll and temper strips
instructions.description: Cool slightly. Cut into strips and roll them up. Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves. Pour over rolls, garnish with coconut, and serve.

title: Thepla
description: Spiced flatbread made of whole wheat flour, fresh fenugreek leaves (methi), and yogurt.

instructions.title: Roll and cook theplas
instructions.description: Knead flour, fenugreek, yogurt, and spices into a dough. Roll thin circular circles, cook on a hot skillet, apply oil, and serve.

title: Handvo
description: A traditional baked savory cake made of mixed lentils, rice, grated bottle gourd, and sesame tempering.

instructions.title: Ferment and bake handvo
instructions.description: Soak and grind rice/lentils. Ferment overnight. Add bottle gourd, pour into pan, sprinkle sesame seeds, bake covered, slice, and serve hot.

title: Misal Pav
description: A spicy sprout curry (usal) topped with crispy farsan, chopped onions, and lemon, served with pav buns.

instructions.title: Simmer sprouts in spicy gravy
instructions.description: Cook sprouts. Make spicy onion-tomato gravy, mix sprouts, and simmer. Toast pav in butter, top misal with onions/farsan, and serve.

title: Sabudana Khichdi
description: A gluten-free breakfast dish made of tapioca pearls (sabudana), roasted peanuts, diced potatoes, and green chilies.

instructions.title: Sauté khichdi base
instructions.description: Soak sabudana. Fry potatoes, cumin, and chilies. Mix sabudana, peanuts, cook gently, add lemon juice, and serve.

title: Pesarattu
description: Andhra style healthy green gram (whole moong dal) crepes, served with ginger chutney.

instructions.title: Spread moon crepe batter
instructions.description: Soak moong. Grind with ginger and chili into batter. Spread thin on hot pan, drizzle oil, cook until crisp, fold, and serve.

title: Rasam
description: A tangy, spicy, and warming South Indian soup made with tamarind, tomatoes, black pepper, cumin, and garlic.

instructions.title: Boil tomato tamarind soup
instructions.description: Prepare tamarind water. Add tomatoes and rasam powder, boil. Add tempered garlic/mustard/curry leaves, simmer, and serve.

title: Avial
description: Traditional Kerala dish containing mixed vegetables cooked in a coconut-yogurt paste, drizzled with coconut oil.

instructions.title: Boil veggies and fold coconut paste
instructions.description: Chop and boil vegetables. Grind coconut and chilies into a paste. Add to vegetables, fold in yogurt, add coconut oil/curry leaves, simmer, and serve.

title: Appam
description: South Indian thin lacy pancakes made of fermented rice batter and coconut milk, soft in the center and crispy on the edges.

instructions.title: Ferment and swirl appam batter
instructions.description: Soak rice, grind with coconut, add yeast and sugar, ferment overnight. Pour batter into hot appam pan, swirl, cover and cook, and serve hot.
